# Crypto Operations Desk

> Independent crypto news for validators and node operators, covering protocol changes, network reliability, staking economics and market infrastructure.

Coverage: Protocol Upgrades, Validator Economics, Network Reliability, Market Infrastructure, Infrastructure Policy.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://cryptoworldnews.github.io/): latest reporting and analysis.
- [About](https://cryptoworldnews.github.io/about/): editorial scope, independence, sourcing and corrections.
- [Archive](https://cryptoworldnews.github.io/archive/): everything published.
